headlines.text: Dow closes up 592 points (1.18%) to 50,774.94, S&P 500 gains 1.6% and Nasdaq surges 2.31% in shortened Black Friday session as chip stocks rebound from a brutal stretch that had the Nasdaq-100 down 20% from its record just days earlier
